nom: Organic Rose Water Spray for Face

avis.texte: I received this about a week ago, it has a beautiful rose scent and is refreshing to put on my face. I haven’t noticed any skin differences but my face is clear. My bottle did come without the pump, I contacted the company via email to ask for one and they provided prompt, exceptional customer service to make it right. So far, I like this and I would order again.

As advertised, pure and simple. Sent this with organic vegetable glycerine to a friend with residual skin itching from radiation therapy and the astringent qualities of rose water in combination with glycerine and purified water worked perfectly to both finish itch and moisturize. My grandmother used this 4oz glycerine, 1iz rose water, 5oz purified water in a spray bottle. Shake well for each use, best right out of the shower. I’ve used this for chronic exams and it does the trick for me. I am NOT A MEDICAL PROFESSIONAL, please do not try this without first consulting a physician. It is intended as a home remedy only!

avis.titre: Pleasant product includes sprayer and glass dropper
avis.texte: Well-packaged glass bottle, very-nicely including a spray cap and glass dropper. The product itself is very pleasant and refreshing. My only concern (and it could be my own faulty perception) is the weakness of the rose scent. Is this the normal intensity of Indian rose water? I've purchased food-grade imported 100% rose water in the past and it smelled much more rosey. This product is a pleasant but weak scent.
Excellent rose water, moisturizer, easy to use spray bottle, you can use it all over, even your hair. Nice smell, gotta love it. Thank you
I like this prodigy; the scent is mild and it feels very moisturizing after I apply on my face. I will continue using this gentle spray.
Exceptional product for skin. Dries slightly tightly, so when used with moisturizer it provides an excellent surface for makeup or bare skin.

Love this rise water appreciate t It’s in a brown glass bottle, I spray my face after my morning cleansing and before/ after if I apply my make up:) would definetly buy again wish they had a large refill bottle:)

I use this rosewater for absolutely everything, but I love it when I can put it in my hair and it helps with moisturizing my hair, balancing my pH on my scalp for itchiness and also helps with detangling my hair leaves it nice and soft and shiny. I absolutely love it. I also use it as a toner on my face and it leaves my skin moisturized and soft and I always get compliments that I smell like roses

avis.titre: 🌹👑 cleopatra would have cleared a shelf for this 👑🌹
avis.texte: i’m going to sound dramatic and i accept that about myself, but ella & eden absolutely nailed this rose water. rose water is one of the most underrated beauty products of all time. i spray myself with it religiously. face, hair, body, spirit. this was the original setting spray millennia ago. there were no silicone mists. there was no “long wear”. there was rose water, confidence, and historical certainty. cleopatra walked so we could mist. the girls who get it, get it. the girls who don’t, please come sit with us. we smell like flowers. i’m happy to share. cleopatra would have gatekept this, but i’m trying to grow. this one is organic, steam distilled, alcohol free, lightweight, and has zero additives or essential oils trying to cosplay as rose water. it’s just organic rose flower water, which is exactly what cleopatra would have demanded before even getting out of bed. the scent is soft, natural, and floral in a fresh petals in a courtyard at dawn way, not in a department store perfume aisle way. i use this on my face daily because i have sad, dry skin that needs gentle hydration and emotional support. it’s perfect as a mid day refresh or before moisturiser when my skin is feeling tight and dramatic. i also spray this on before applying musk al tahara, which feels extremely correct historically, spiritually, and cosmetically. this is absolutely something cleopatra would have ritualised. hair wise, this is elite. a few mists smooth things down, add softness, and make your ha

avis.titre: Refreshing rose water spray with a delicate scent & cooling effect (but get a separate spray bottle)
avis.texte: I like this rose water a lot so far. I appreciate the large size of the bottle, the scent is really nice, and there’s even a little plastic thing on the underside of the cap that prevents it from leaking. They also provide a separate spray top but it’s honestly kinda crappy. The mist is not a fine mist like you want for a facial spray and it comes out sparingly in a few blobs of fluid. Maybe it’s just the one I got. No biggie. I feel like the bottle is quite large for a spray top like that so I’m going to keep the regular leak-proof top on it and refill a small empty bottle I have that has a really fine mist sprayer. I would recommend doing this regardless. The rose water itself is nice and refreshing, it feels cool when it hits your skin, and it smells really good without being overpowering and nauseating like some floral sprays can be— especially some of those sickly fake rose scents that remind me of the bottom of an old lady’s purse. The way they pack it into the shipping box makes sense too— they use these odd-shaped egg crate type of cardboard… thingies (lol) to prevent it from breaking. They include a couple of cards with info about the brand and offer a free e-book with tips and recipes— I’m excited to see what all they recommend doing with this product. They also print a very clear expiration date on the side of the bottle, thankfully. They recommend using it as a toner, a makeup setting spray, and as a refreshing soothing spray for the hair and scalp. Pretty sweet!

The Ella & Eden 100% Pure Organic Rose Water Spray (8oz) is such a refreshing, simple staple to have. I love that it’s USDA Organic, steam-distilled, alcohol-free, and has no additives. You can really tell it’s pure, the scent is light, natural, and not overpowering or artificial. It gives that fresh, true rose smell without being too strong. On the face, it feels instantly hydrating and soothing. It’s perfect as a light toner, a mid-day refresh, or to prep the skin before applying moisturizer. On the hair, it adds a soft touch of moisture without weighing it down. The glass bottle also feels high quality and keeps everything feeling clean and premium. Overall, it’s a gentle, versatile product that does exactly what it claims, refreshes and hydrates without any unnecessary extras. Good value for money.
Didn’t care for it Didn’t have a strong rose scent like my others The one to get is heritage’s store it smell just like roses

100% organic --- absolutely LOVE this spray. Has a light floral scent, does not feel sticky or overwhelming. Very effective for hydration and makes my face feel refreshed and moisturized. I have carried this in my gym bag to spray on after workouts and I really like the clean feeling. Great value for the money and I am really appreciative that this is 100% organic, no GMO and especially cruelty free---those are the 3 main elements that I look for in skincare.
Arrived, but WITHOUT the spray top. I'm afraid to even open the bottle. Someone obviously returned this but took the spray nozzle out of the box first. >:-(

avis.titre: Absolutely beautiful light rose smell and so hydrating!
avis.texte: This is a 100% pure organic rose spray for the face and body…even your hair! It smells wonderful! It’s not an overpowering smell of roses, but just enough and the smell is a beautiful rose smell, not an old rose smell. It comes in an amber bottle so it won’t be affected by any light. It’s a great size (8oz) for the price! I will say the sprayer looked and felt flimsy (it’s separate..you put it on yourself), but it’s worked fine, no problems! This is high quality, organic, non GMO, and vegan. I use this on my face as a hydrating toner and I love the way it hydrates my face and love the light rose smell it leaves. I’ve also sprayed it in my hair, it is a fine mist, and too soon to tell if it’s beneficial for my hair, but it is nice to give my hair a refreshing touch up to smell nice!

The Ella & Eden brand products have added such a nice touch to my beauty routine, and this 100% Pure Organic Rose Water Spray has been no different! It has so many beneficial uses for your skin and hair. I like to use it as a facial toner in the morning for a beautifully floral wake-up call and also apply it to my hair after washing and towel drying to add some extra shine and a nice rose scent. It was very thoughtfully made; The ingredients are just 100% pure organic rose flower water made from steam distilling. The amber glass bottle helps maintain the quality of the product as well. You also get an 8oz bottle, so quite a bit compared to some competitors with lesser products. Overall, I love this brand, and I especially love this product from them! I will definitely be back for more once I eventually run out of this bottle!

avis.titre: Pure, Refreshing Rose Water with a Clean Formula
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Ella & Eden Organic Rose Water spray daily, and it’s quickly become a staple in my routine. The mist is very fine and evenly distributed, making it refreshing without feeling heavy or sticky. It provides a light boost of hydration and works well as a mid-day face refresher or after cleansing. What I appreciate most is the simple, clean ingredient profile. It’s truly alcohol-free with no added fragrances or additives, and the natural rose scent is soft and subtle—not overpowering. My skin is on the sensitive side, and this has been gentle and calming with no irritation. I’ve also used it on my hair to help refresh dry ends and tame flyaways, and it adds a nice touch of softness. The glass bottle feels high quality and helps keep the product fresh. Overall, this is a versatile, well-made rose water that’s easy to incorporate into everyday face and hair care routines.

avis.titre: Refreshing, Versatile, and a Great Everyday Rose Water
avis.texte: I’ve been really enjoying this rose water. I mostly use it as a facial mist after washing my face or during the day when my skin feels dry and needs a refresh. I also spray a little on my hair to help with frizz or when I want a light boost of moisture. The scent is very soft and natural, not overly floral or fake. Compared to other rose waters I’ve tried, this one feels clean and straightforward. I like that it comes in a glass bottle and includes a sprayer, which makes it easy to use without wasting product. I believe it’s made in the USA, which is a nice bonus. For the size and quality, it’s a good value and lasts a long time. It’s one of those simple products that I reach for often, and I would definitely repurchase it.

avis.titre: Good Size, Great Spray Nozzle and Feels Great
avis.texte: I don't have sensitive skin, but my face can react to some additives in beauty products. I am happy to say that this rose water feels fresh and didn't bother me at all. The works really well with a lot of cover area so it only takes a couple of sprits to cover my whole face. I do have a sensitive scalp to the point where I can't use a lot of products, but this also cause no reaction there either. It's good size, came with a long enough expiration date to allow for a long time of uses and it smells great. I really enjoy this product.

This is a very high quality rose water and in a generous portion. The water is made in the US by a company that really seems to take pride in their product. The spray bottle is a quality dark glass which helps maintain the quality of the water. The spray emits a perfect amount of fine mist for the face or anywhere else. The scent is rosy but not overly so and the rosewater feels very pure . I'm super pleased with the quality of the product, the soft, subtle scent and the excellent storage container.

I forgot how much I loved using rosewater on my face until I picked up this product again! A little bit about my skin: early 30s, acne scarring and mild hormonal acne breakouts on occasion, texture, early signs of fine lines. I try to use all-natural products as much as possible for my overall health, as well as avoiding any hormones disruptions. I have used this product as part of my evening skincare for 3 nights in a row so far and am ALREADY seeing a positive change in my skin. The texture is softening and smoothing out, and my skin is definitely glowier and smoother as a result. This product is by no means a "miracle" product - don't expect to wake up looking like an airbrushed celebrity - but it is a great addition to my skincare routine. Pros: - Comes in a tinted glass bottle - no sneaky microplastics! - Comes with a separate spritzer cap along with the standard reusable screw-on cap, so you can choose how you want to use it. (Personally, I threw away the screw-on cap and just leave the spray cap on.) - Sweet, light floral smell from the natural floral essences of the product- if you're used to most clean rosewater toners and products, then this one shouldn't bother you. - Easy to use - just spritz on your face with the spritzer OR unscrew and pour on to a cotton pad (avoid cotton balls that will soak up too much of the product). I prefer using a cotton pad to avoid product waste by spraying the product, as some of it ended up in my hair or on the wall behind me. - Made

avis.titre: Lovely rose water. No sprayer included.
avis.texte: This rose water is very nice. It feels very nice on my face when I use the rose water as a toner. After using it for about a week, I think it has helped with some redness that I have been having around my nose. I received this rose water glass bottle without any sprayer included so I had to recycle one of favorite face toner mist bottle and dumped the content of this rose water into it. For this reason I deducted a star as the product came incomplete. Otherwise, I would definitely order this product again. It's reasonably priced and very good quality.

avis.texte: What's not to love? It's delightful!! This is my first experience with Rose Water, butbwhat a way to start the day! Revive throughout the day! And relax at the end of the day! I took off the lid and inserted the spray th8ngy included and now it sits on my bedside table. Happiness in a bottle and you're allowed to still drive. Lol! 💜💜💜

Very disappointed. Let me explain why I do believe it matters. The human body is filled with microplastics. I preferred this bottle for three reasons. 1st, we use castor oil in our house for many reasons and health benefits as well as surgical healing. 2nd we only buy from USA made products. This bottle is not squared and made in America and is only bottled here. This means it’s much harder for the USDA to certify organic. Certified organic also has little meaning these days and the bar is so low for “organic” that it’s easy to be deceived. Another very large problem is I was mislead. The picture clearly shows “glass bottle”. Castor oil is a penetrating oil and can break down tissue internally in the body. So housing castor oil in plastic containers is unacceptable. My wife is incredibly disappointed and so am I. We needed this for today and had it expressed delivered to only find out it’s a PLASTIC BOTTLE. Why lie to your customers and post the only image of the product with “GLASS BOTTLE”. It obviously matters to customers. It matters to us. Also, why put a beautiful American flag on it when it is not sourced and made in the USA. Sure it’s bottled here but not made. Just more deception. Will not purchase again and will stick with our previous brand we love that meets every all the perimeters I just described.
